item.title: Gentoo Media - Notification of trade
item.description: MJ Foundation Fundacja Rodzinna, an entity closely associated with Mateusz Juroszek (Board Member and primary insider of Gentoo Media Inc.), yesterday acquired 28 100 shares in Gentoo Media at an average price of SEK 3.95928 per share. Following this transaction, MJ Foundation Fundacja Rodzinna holds 22 617 932 shares, representing 16,79% of the total outstanding shares and voting rights in Gentoo Media Inc. Total holdings by close associates of Mateusz Juroszek now stand at 29 060 958 shares. For further information, please contact: Sebastian Mortensen, Head of Investor Relations,
